text: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday by 8 PM but tracking still says in transit. Where is it?
reference_reply: We understand your concern regarding the delivery delay. Please check tracking status at amazon.com/your-orders. If it doesn't arrive in 24 hours, let us know!

text: Tracking says delivered on front porch at 3 PM but I was home all day and nothing is here! Look into my account ASAP!
reference_reply: We are very sorry your package is missing. Please check around your porch. If still missing, send us a DM with your order details so we can investigate securely.

text: Ordered a birthday gift with Prime 1-day shipping 3 days ago. This is completely unacceptable service.
reference_reply: We sincerely apologize for missing your delivery deadline. Please send us a direct message with your order number so our team can prioritize this.

text: Can you tell me which carrier is handling tracking number TBA982348123019?
reference_reply: TBA tracking numbers are handled by Amazon Logistics. You can view real-time progress directly on amazon.com/your-orders.

text: Driver threw the package over my fence into the dog pen! Box is soaked and chewed.
reference_reply: We are truly sorry to hear about this. Please DM us your order ID and address details so we can report this carrier issue and issue a replacement.

text: Is Sunday delivery available for standard non-prime shipping in Chicago?
reference_reply: Delivery availability on Sundays depends on the carrier and specific postal code. You will see exact delivery dates during checkout.

text: Tracking has been stuck on 'Carrier picked up package' for 5 days with no update.
reference_reply: Sometimes tracking scans are delayed between hubs. If your package passes the estimated delivery date on amazon.com/your-orders, please reach out!

text: Package stolen from doorstep. Police report #94819. I demand a full refund or legal action.
reference_reply: We take this matter seriously. Please send us a private DM with your order ID and police report details so our escalation team can assist directly.

text: I dropped off my return at Kohl's 6 days ago. When will I get my refund back to my card?
reference_reply: Once received, refunds to credit cards typically take 3 to 5 business days to reflect. You can monitor status at amazon.com/returns.

text: You refunded me $24.99 but the item cost $49.99! Why was only half refunded?
reference_reply: We apologize for the refund discrepancy. Please send us a DM with your order number so a support agent can review the transaction breakdown.

text: How long do I have to return an unopened electronics item bought during Prime Day?
reference_reply: Standard return window for most items is 30 days from delivery. Check specific return eligibility dates on your Orders section.

text: Returned an iPhone 3 weeks ago via UPS tracking 1Z9999, still no refund of $1100. This is theft.
reference_reply: We understand your frustration regarding this high-value refund delay. Please DM us your order ID and UPS receipt to resolve this immediately.

text: Can I get a refund directly to my Amazon Gift Card balance instead of my expired card?
reference_reply: Yes! When initiating a return at amazon.com/returns, choose 'Amazon Gift Card balance' for faster processing, usually within 2-4 hours of drop-off.

text: Item was marked non-returnable but it arrived leaking dangerous chemical liquid!
reference_reply: We are so sorry for this safety concern. Do not handle the item. Send us a private DM with your order ID for an immediate safety exception refund.

text: I lost the original packaging, can I still return the item at Whole Foods?
reference_reply: Yes! Whole Foods and Kohl's drop-off locations offer packaging-free and label-free returns for eligible items with return QR codes.

text: Opened my package and the glass vase is completely shattered into pieces.
reference_reply: We are so sorry your vase arrived broken! You can request an instant replacement or refund via amazon.com/returns without shipping broken glass back.

text: The laptop I received has deep scratches and won't turn on. Replacement unit arrived damaged too!
reference_reply: We sincerely apologize for receiving two consecutive damaged laptops. Please send us a DM with order details so a supervisor can oversee resolution.

text: Received a shampoo bottle that opened and leaked all over the books in the same box.
reference_reply: We apologize for the damaged shipment. Please visit amazon.com/returns to request replacements for both items right away.

text: My new TV screen is cracked out of the box. $1500 wasted.
reference_reply: We are terribly sorry for the damaged television delivery. Please DM us your order number so we can arrange a priority replacement or refund.

text: Ordered size 10 shoes but received size 7 in the box.
reference_reply: We apologize for the mix-up! Select 'Wrong item sent' at amazon.com/returns to generate a free return label and get the correct size shipped.

text: Food item arrived 4 months past its expiration date. Someone could get sick!
reference_reply: We apologize for this unacceptable quality oversight. Please DM us your order details so our inventory safety team can investigate and refund you.

text: I received an email about a $700 iPhone order I never placed. Is my account hacked?
reference_reply: If you suspect unauthorized activity, change your password at amazon.com and DM us your account email so our fraud prevention team can secure it.

text: Locked out of my account because 2-factor OTP is going to an old discontinued phone number.
reference_reply: To recover an account with outdated 2FA, please use the Two-Step Verification Recovery page on amazon.com/help or DM us to begin verification.

text: Got a text saying 'Your Amazon package is on hold, click here to pay $2'. Is this real?
reference_reply: This is a known phishing scam! Amazon will never ask for payment or sensitive info via unsolicited text. Report to stop-spoofing@amazon.com.

text: Someone changed the email address on my Amazon account and added their credit card.
reference_reply: Please contact our Account Security team immediately. Send us a DM with your original account details so we can freeze unauthorized activity.

text: How do I update my billing address on file for my saved cards?
reference_reply: You can update your payment methods and billing addresses anytime by visiting 'Your Payments' in your Account settings at amazon.com.

text: Why was I charged $139 for Prime membership renewal when I had auto-renew turned off?
reference_reply: We apologize for the unexpected charge. You can cancel for a full refund at amazon.com/gp/primecentral or DM us for assistance.

text: How do I share my Prime benefits with my spouse or family members?
reference_reply: You can share Prime shipping and digital benefits by creating an Amazon Household under your Account Settings at amazon.com/myh/households.

text: My credit card was charged twice for order #112-9848192-3849182.
reference_reply: Duplicate charges are often temporary authorization holds that drop off in 2-3 days. Please DM us your order ID so we can verify the charge.

text: Does Prime Student discount continue automatically after graduation?
reference_reply: Prime Student discount lasts up to 4 years or until graduation. You will receive an email before it transitions to standard Prime pricing.

text: My Fire TV stick is stuck in a boot loop showing the logo and restarting constantly.
reference_reply: Try unplugging the power adapter for 60 seconds and plugging into a wall outlet rather than TV USB. If issue persists, visit amazon.com/devicesupport.

text: Echo Dot 4th Gen stopped responding to 'Alexa' and has a solid red ring.
reference_reply: A solid red ring means the microphone is muted. Press the microphone button on top of the device to unmute.

text: Kindle Paperwhite screen has frozen horizontal lines and touch isn't working after update.
reference_reply: Please hold the power button for 40 seconds to perform a hard reset. If unresolved, DM us for warranty replacement options.

text: Purchased a movie on Prime Video in 4K UHD but it only streams in 480p SD resolution.
reference_reply: Streaming quality depends on internet speed (min 15 Mbps for 4K) and HDCP 2.2 compatible HDMI ports. Check Prime Video settings.

text: Huge shoutout to driver Mike in Seattle who carried heavy pet food all the way up my stairs!
reference_reply: Thank you so much for sharing! We will make sure Mike's fulfillment station receives your praise!

text: The new Amazon iOS app update made search filters much harder to find. Please fix.
reference_reply: Thank you for sharing this feedback. Our app design team is actively monitoring user feedback to improve search navigation.

text: Delivery van was speeding dangerously down a school zone and almost hit a child.
reference_reply: Safety is our top priority. Please send us a private DM immediately with the time, date, street location, and van license plate.

text: Does Amazon donate returned items to local charities or throw them away?
reference_reply: Through programs like Amazon FBA Donations, eligible returned items are donated to charitable organizations worldwide.
